column2: /s00Here I'll show you how to build a store./rIt's a lot, but let's take it one step at a time!/w045/kB/s00/pFirst, choose where to build your store./w045/kB/s00/pSpots with lots of buildings are good, but the land costs more there./w045/kB/s00/pCheck your /c2funds/c0 and pick a spot you can afford./w045/kB/s00/pChoose a spot with the /c1D-pad/c0, then press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s00/s10/i10/s00/m(4,250,22)(9,5,255,460,4)Once you've picked a spot, choose your /c4Store Size/c0./w045/kB/s00/pBigger stores draw more customers, but at first you can only build small ones./w045/kB/s00/pBigger stores also mean more work for your /c3clerks/c0, so think about balance./w045/kB/s00/pPick a store size level and confirm with the /c1○ button/c0./w045/kB/s00/pThis time only the smallest size is available, so just/rconfirm with the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,420,50)(3,5,15,600,2)After the size, you get your /c4Sales Licenses/c0./w045/kB/s00/pTo sell alcohol, tobacco or medicine, you need a /c4Sales License/c0./w045/kB/s00/pSome /c4Sales Licenses/c0 can't be had in certain spots, so be careful./w045/kB/s00/pThis time, let's skip the /c4Sales Licenses/c0./w045/kB/s00/pUse the /c1D-pad/c0 to move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0./w045/s00/s12/i12/s00/w045/s98/kV/s00/pPress the /c1○ button/c0 to confirm./w045/s80/kB/s00/pNext up is /c4Edit Interior/c0./w045/kB/s00/pThis is the most important part of /c2The Conveni/c0./w045/kB/s00/pSo learn it well!/w045/kB/s00/pThe bottom left shows the /c2fixture/c0 category you've picked./w045/kB/s00/pAnd to its right are the kinds of /c2fixtures/c0./w045/kB/s00/pPick a /c2fixture/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and place it/rwith the /c1○ button/c0./w045/kB/s00/pBe sure to place at least one /c2register/c0, /c2break room/c0 and /c2shelf/c0./w045/kB/s00/pWithout those three, you can't open./w045/kB/s00/pYour main store already has some of the /c2fixtures/c0 it needs./w045/kB/s00/pAt first, use that layout as a guide./w045/kB/s00/pNow let's open the menu./rPress the /c1□ button/c0./w045/s82/kE/s00/p/m(4,225,180)(2,155,50,460,3)This is the /c4Edit Interior/c0 menu./w045/kB/s00/p/c3Load/c0 reads a layout from your /c2memory card (PS2)/c0,/w045/kB/s00/pand /c3Save/c0 stores a layout you've made./w045/kB/s00/p/c3Load/c0 also offers 3 ready-made layouts from the start,/w045/kB/s00/pso use those until you get the hang of it, then make them your own bit by bit./w045/kB/s00/pPick /c3Done Editing/c0 to move on. Press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,395,15)(9,155,210,460,4)Next, let's hire some /c3clerks/c0./w045/kB/s00/pThe top box is the /c3manager/c0./rThe two below are /c3clerks/c0./w045/kB/s00/pWithout a /c3manager/c0 the store can't open, so remember that!/w045/kB/s00/pLet's hire a /c3manager/c0 right now. Move the /c2cursor/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0 on the /c3manager/c0/rslot./w045/s00/s99/i30/s00/pThis shows details on your current /c3manager/c0. You haven't hired one yet, so it's empty./w045/kB/s00/pPut the /c2cursor/c0 on /c3Hire/c0 and/rpress the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/p/m(4,395,15)(9,155,242,460,3)Here come the /c2resumes/c0./w045/kB/s00/pA /c2resume/c0 shows a person's name, photo, skills, work history and more./w045/kB/s00/pScroll a /c2resume/c0 with /c1D-pad/c0 up and down, and pick with /c1D-pad/c0 left and right./w045/kB/s00/pNow let's hire someone. Pick with /c1D-pad/c0 left and right, then press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s15/kB/s00/pYou've hired a /c3manager/c0!/w045/kB/s00/pHiring other /c3clerks/c0 works the same way./w045/kB/s00/pA /c3manager/c0 is all you need to open, so press /c3OK/c0 for now and move on./w045/kB/s00/pMove the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s00/s16/i16/s00/m(4,424,189)(6,5,319,490,3)/pNext, let's set your /c3clerks'/c0 pay./w045/kB/s00/pThe top item is the /c3Raise Rate/c0: how much pay goes up once a year./w045/kB/s00/pAround 1～3％ is usually fine. Let's leave the /c3Raise Rate/c0 as it is./w045/kB/s00/pPress /c1D-pad/c0 up to move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3Pay Talks/c0./w045/s93/kP/s00/pThis decides what to do when /c3clerks/c0 ask, "Can I get a raise?"/w045/kB/s00/pPress the /c1○ button/c0 to make a choice./w045/s80/kB/s00/pYou can decide each raise yourself, or give them automatically./w045/kB/s00/pLet's go with /c3Auto-Accept/c0./rPress /c1D-pad/c0 down./w045/s97/kU/s00/pNow it's set to /c3Auto-Accept/c0. Confirm with the /c1○ button/c0./w045/s80/kB/s00/pOnce you're used to it, try handling them one by one. But if you keep saying no to raises,/w045/kB/s00/pyour /c3clerks/c0 may get fed up and quit!/w045/kB/s00/pDon't lose your precious /c3clerks/c0. Give them fair raises!/w045/kB/s00/pNow move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0 to go on./w045/s00/s17/i17/s00/m(4,419,189)(6,15,279,448,4)Next, let's set your store hours./w045/kB/s00/pIn the box below, press the /c1○ button/c0 to open or close each hour./w045/kB/s00/p/m(4,397,113)(6,15,146,448,4)The /c4Quick Hours Setup/c0 above sets the hours in one go./w045/kB/s00/pIt starts at 7 AM to 11 PM./rThat's usually fine as is./w045/kB/s00/pShady customers might show up late at night, after all./w045/kB/s00/pUntil your /c2Security/c0 goes up, better not open 24 hours./w045/kB/s00/pLater, when your store's /c2Security/c0 is higher, try going 24 hours!/w045/kB/s00/pNow move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0 to go on./w045/s00/s19/i19/s00/p/m(4,419,189)(6,15,279,448,4)Next, let's set the /c4Price Rate/c0 for your goods./w045/kB/s00/pA /c4Price Rate/c0 of 100％ is list price. Lower is a discount, higher is a markup./w045/kB/s00/pCheaper draws more customers, but too cheap and you won't make a profit. Careful!/w045/kB/s00/pThe top changes everything at once; the bottom changes each product./rLet's leave it as is./w045/kB/s00/p/m(4,397,113)(6,15,146,448,4)Now move the /c2cursor/c0 to /c3OK/c0 with the /c1D-pad/c0 and press the /c1○ button/c0 to go on./w045/s00/s18/i18/s00/m(4,128,128)(2,52,27,420,4)And your very own store is built!/w045/kB/s00/pRebuilding or building new stores works the same way, so remember it well!/w045/kB/s00/pSee you again! Have fun with the game!/w045/kB/s00/p
